EmailSettings._comment: Provider selects delivery: 'Resend' (HTTPS API, works where SMTP is blocked) or 'Smtp'. SMTP Username/Password are SECRETS — never put them here; use env vars (prod) or User Secrets (dev).

Resend._comment: ApiKey is a SECRET. Do NOT put it here. Set the Resend__ApiKey environment variable (prod) or use User Secrets (dev). FromAddress domain must be verified in the Resend dashboard.
